verdict.rationale: Ollama provides a one-line curl install script (ollama-docs-14) and community comments describe it as very easy to install and use (ollama-comm-6, ollama-comm-15), but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of installation via a standard package manager like brew, apt, or winget. Missing for 10: documented brew/apt/winget package manager install commands, first-party docs confirming package manager support.
